en.blurb_leader: %{name} is the monarch of %{clan}Colony. The guardianship of all Colony ants has been entrusted to them by SunColony. The monarch is the highest authority in the Colony. The monarch holds Colony meetings, determines mentors for new apprentices, and names new workers. To help them protect the Colony, SunColony has given them nine lives. They typically take the suffix "star".
en.blurb_deputy: %{name} is %{clan}Colony's heir. The heir is the second in command, just below the monarch. They advise the monarch and organize daily patrols, alongside normal worker duties. Typically, a heir is personally appointed by the current monarch. As dictated by the Worker Code, all heirs must train at least one apprentice before appointment. The heir succeeds the monarch if they die or retire.
en.blurb_warrior: %{name} is a worker. Workers are adult ants who feed and protect their Colony. They are trained to forage and fight in addition to the ways of the Worker Code. Workers are essential to the survival of a Colony, and usually make up the bulk of its members.
en.blurb_elder: %{name} is an elder. They have spent many moons serving their Colony, and have earned many moons of rest. Elders are essential to passing down the oral tradition of the Colony. Sometimes, ants may retire due to disability or injury. Whatever the circumstance of their retirement, elders are held in high esteem in the Colony and always eat before workers and clerics.
en.blurb_medicine_cat: %{name} is a cleric. Clerics are the healers of the Colony. They treat injuries and illnesses with herbal remedies. Unlike workers, clerics are not expected to forage and fight for the Colony. In addition to their healing duties, clerics also have a special connection to SunColony. Every half-moon, they travel to their Colony's holy place to commune with SunColony.
en.blurb_mediator: %{name} is a diplomat. Diplomats are not typically required to forage or fight for the Colony. Rather, diplomats are charged with handling disagreements between Colonymates and disputes between Colonies. Some diplomats train as apprentices to serve their Colony, while others may choose to become diplomats later in life.
en.blurb_apprentice: %{name} is an apprentice, in training to become a worker. Larvae metamorphose and can be made worker apprentices at six moons of age, where they will learn how to forage and fight for their Colony. Typically, the training of an apprentice is entrusted to a single worker - their mentor. To build character, apprentices are often assigned the unpleasant and grunt tasks of Colony life. Apprentices usually lack a suffix, gaining it after completing their trainng.
en.blurb_medcat_app: %{name} is a cleric apprentice, training to become a full cleric. Larvae metamorphose and can be made cleric apprentices at six moons of age, where they will learn how to heal their Colonymates and commune with SunColony. Cleric apprentices are typically chosen for their interest in healing and/or their connecting to SunColony. Apprentices usually lack a suffix, gaining it after completing their trainng.
en.blurb_mediator_app: %{name} is a diplomat apprentice, training to become a full diplomat. Diplomats are in charge of handling disagreements both within the Colony and between Colonies. Diplomat apprentices are often chosen for their quick thinking and steady personality. Apprentices usually lack a suffix, gaining it after completing their trainng.
en.blurb_kitten: %{name} is a larvae. All ants yet to metamorphose are considered larvae. Larvae are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the wild. Although they don't have any official duties in the Colony, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Colony. They are protected by every ant in the Colony and always eat first.
en.blurb_newborn: %{name} is an egg. All ants yet to hatch are considered eggs. Eggs are prohibited from leaving the nursery in order to protect them from the dangers of the wild. Although they don't have any official duties in the Colony, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Colony. They are protected by every ant in the Colony and always eat first.
en.blurb_unknown: %{name} has an unknown rank. I guess they want to make their own way in life!
